topic: C9 asked a unit test to prove model behaviour
lesson: GRANTED-1-C9 required a replay to make the dispatcher call FIRST, but choosing a tool is the model's act; with no model in a unit test something must do the selecting, so every implementation of it was judged synthetic. The criterion is amended to what is provable and still meaningful: the materialization is built through the production path, contains the descriptor, the real dispatcher registration accepts exactly the descriptor's values, and removing the descriptor leaves nothing to call. First-call ordering is evidenced by the live run instead. Do not re-raise the selection conditional as a defect.
